```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


### Configure environment. Load data.

```{r, warning=F, message=F}

source(here::here("0-config.R"))

```


## Format panels for Figure 2 (6 panels)

### Add km scale and grappes option to district panels. 
```{r}

map_district_means_tx0_v2 <- 
  map_district_means_tx0 +
  # geom_sf(data=d_sf, alpha=0.9, size=0.5, shape=1) + #grappes
  ggspatial::annotation_scale()
  

map_district_means_tx1_v2 <- 
  map_district_means_tx1 +
  # geom_sf(data=d_sf, alpha=0.9, size=0.5, shape=1) + #grappes
  ggspatial::annotation_scale()

map_district_means_all_v2 <- 
  map_district_means_all +
  # geom_sf(data=d_sf, alpha=0.9, size=0.5, shape=1) + #grappes
  ggspatial::annotation_scale()

   # geom_sf_text(aes(label = adm_02), 
   #             size=2.5,
   #             fontface="bold")

map_district_means_ate_v2 <- 
  map_district_means_ate +
  ggspatial::annotation_scale()


map_district_means_all_v2; map_district_means_tx0_v2; map_district_means_tx1_v2; map_district_means_ate_v2

```

### Remove grappes from spatial est. panels. Align scales. Update Bayesian scale colors.
```{r}

map_mort_tx0_child_v2 <- 
  create_mort_map_2(raster2 = b_preds_mort_raster2_tx1_child,
                               agetxt  = "(1 to 59)",
                               tagtxt  = "B",
                               add_grappes = F) +
  ggspatial::annotation_scale()


map_mort_tx1_child_v2 <- 
  create_mort_map_2(raster2 = b_preds_mort_raster2_tx0_child,
                               agetxt  = "(1 to 59)",
                               tagtxt  = "C",
                               add_grappes = F) +
  ggspatial::annotation_scale()

map_mort_diff_child_v2 <- 
  create_mort_map_2(raster2 = b_preds_mort_raster2_diff_child,
                               agetxt  = "(1 to 59)",
                               tagtxt  = "E",
                               min = -7, max = 2,
                               paletteopt = 2,
                               legtxt = "ATE: difference in mortality per 1000 person-years",
                               add_grappes = F) +
  ggspatial::annotation_scale()

map_mort_probeff_child_v2 <- 
  create_mort_map_2(raster2 = sims_mort_probeff_raster2,
                               agetxt  = "(1 to 59)",
                               tagtxt  = "F",
                               min = 0.5, max = 0.75,
                               paletteopt = 3,
                               legtxt = "Posterior Pr(mortality ATE < 0)",
                               add_grappes = F) +
  ggspatial::annotation_scale()

map_mort_tx0_child_v2; map_mort_tx1_child_v2; map_mort_diff_child_v2; map_mort_probeff_child_v2

```


## Combine panels.
```{r}

fig2_tx0 <- 
  ggarrange(map_district_means_tx0_v2, map_mort_tx0_child_v2, map_mort_tx1_child_v2,
          map_district_means_ate_v2, map_mort_diff_child_v2, map_mort_probeff_child_v2,
          nrow = 2, ncol = 3)

fig2_tx1 <- 
  ggarrange(map_district_means_tx1_v2, map_mort_tx0_child_v2, map_mort_tx1_child_v2,
          map_district_means_ate_v2, map_mort_diff_child_v2, map_mort_probeff_child_v2,
          nrow = 2, ncol = 3)

fig2_all <- 
  ggarrange(map_district_means_all_v2, map_mort_tx0_child_v2, map_mort_tx1_child_v2,
          map_district_means_ate_v2, map_mort_diff_child_v2, map_mort_probeff_child_v2,
          nrow = 2, ncol = 3)

```

## Save maps.
```{r}

ggsave(filename = paste0(figure_path,"avenir-spatial-ATE-fig-2-tx0-",Sys.Date(),".png"),
       fig2_tx0,
       device = "png", 
       width = 350,
       height = 300,
       units = "mm")

ggsave(filename = paste0(figure_path,"avenir-spatial-ATE-fig-2-tx0-",Sys.Date(),".pdf"),
       fig2_tx0,
       device = "pdf", 
       width = 350,
       height = 300,
       units = "mm")

ggsave(filename = paste0(figure_path,"avenir-spatial-ATE-fig-2-tx1-",Sys.Date(),".png"),
       fig2_tx1,
       device = "png", 
       width = 350,
       height = 300,
       units = "mm")

ggsave(filename = paste0(figure_path,"avenir-spatial-ATE-fig-2-tx1-",Sys.Date(),".pdf"),
       fig2_tx1,
       device = "pdf", 
       width = 350,
       height = 300,
       units = "mm")

ggsave(filename = paste0(figure_path,"avenir-spatial-ATE-fig-2-all-",Sys.Date(),".png"),
       fig2_all,
       device = "png", 
       width = 350,
       height = 300,
       units = "mm")

ggsave(filename = paste0(figure_path,"avenir-spatial-ATE-fig-2-all-",Sys.Date(),".pdf"),

       device = "pdf", 
       width = 350,
       height = 300,
       units = "mm")

```
